questions.question: Generally unemployment in a developing country takes place because of ___________.

options.text: Lack of complementary factors of production
Switch over from one job to another

questions.solution:
Generally, unemployment in a developing country takes place because of lack of complementary factors of production.

 
• There are four factors of production- land, labor, capital and organization/entrepreneurship.
 
• If the country is not able to generate employment opportunities to gainfully engage and involve these factors of production, the required amount of output cannot be produced and income cannot be generated, which usually, results in unemployment.
 
• Unemployment is the condition when a large number of able-bodied people of working age, who are willing to work but could not find work at the current wage levels.
 
• As of 2018, round about 31 million Indians are unemployed.
 
• Types of Unemployment are as follows:

 
 

 
 
1

 
 
 
Frictional Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to temporary unemployment associated with the changing of jobs in the dynamic economy.

 
 
 

 
 
2

 
 
 
Structural Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to unemployment that occurs due to the long-term decline of certain industries.

 
 
 

 
 
3

 
 
 
Seasonal Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to unemployment that results from a change in taste, fashion, and season.

 
 
 

 
 
4

 
 
 
Voluntary Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to unemployment that results when people are not willing to work at a certain wage rate, even when the work is available.

 
 
 

 
 
5

 
 
 
Involuntary Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to unemployment that occurs when the people are ready to work but there are not enough job opportunities.

 
 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
Cyclic Unemployment

 
 
 
Refers to unemployment that occurs as a result of the business cycle. E.g. In case of economic recession in a country, job opportunities decrease, workers get laid off from a job, etc.

questions.question: The highest mountain peak of Chhotanagpur Plateau is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Parasnath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parasnath**

 
 
• Parasnath Hills are a range of hills located in the Giridih district of Jharkhand.
 
• The highest peak is 1370 meters.
 
 
• It is one of the most important pilgrimage centers for Jains.
 
• They call it Sammed Sikhar. The hill is named after Parasnath, the 23rd Tirthankara.
 
• Twenty of the twenty-four Jain Tirthankaras attained salvation on this hill.

• Mount Dhupgarh is the highest point peak situated in the Mahadeo Hills (Satpura Range), Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• Pachmarhi Hill station is situated near the peak.
 
• Pachmarhi is a hill station located in the Hoshangabad district of Madhya Pradesh state of central India.
 
• It has been the destination of a cantonment since British Raj.
 
• It is extensively known as Satpura ki Rani ("Queen of Satpura"), situated at a height of 1067 m in a valley of the Satpura Range in the Hoshangabad district.

• **​Pachmarhi**
 
 
• ​It, also known as Satpura ki Rani, is a hill station in the central Indian state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Its many waterfalls include Apsara Vihar, with its calm pool, and soaring, single-drop Silver Fall nearby.
 
• The Bee Fall tumbles over a jagged rock face to the northwest.
 
• Leopards and Indian bison live in Satpura National Park.
 
• The ancient Pandav Caves are a group of 5 dwellings cut out of sandstone on a hill.
 
 
 
• **Mahabaleshwar**
 
 
• Mahabaleshwar is situated at Sahyadri mountain range in the Satara District of Maharastra.
 
• Its name is derived from a Lord Mahadev temple and three Sanskrit words, Maha (great), Bal (power) and Ishwar (God).

questions.question: Elements having same atomic numbers but a different mass number are called ______.
questions.solution:
Elements having same atomic numbers but a different mass number are called Isotopes.

 
• Isotopes have different physical properties and similar chemical properties.

 
• They are the atoms of the same element having the same numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
 
• They have same chemical properties due to the same electronic configuration but different physical properties.

questions.question: Organs having different structures and components but performing similar functions are called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Analogous organs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Analogous organs: The organs which are different anatomically but similar functionally are called analogous organs.
 
• Eg. Wings of butterflies, birds, and bats, the Eyes of octopuses & mammals, and Flippers of penguins & dolphins.
 
• All these have different anatomical structures but they perform the same function like Wings of butterfly, birds & bats differs in structure but all of them perform the function of flight.
 
• Analogous organs always show convergent evolution.
 
• In convergent evolution, the species of different ancestry start sharing analogous traits because of selection pressure or shared environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39a8521eaebbae5600ec9badb02e989a50df34eea0e034c595e3e501d373c342.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Homologous organs: The organs which are similar in structural design & origin i.e. same anatomical structure but different in functions are called Homologous organs.
 
• Eg. The forelimbs of some animals like whales, bats & cheetah have similar anatomical structures i.e., humerus, radius, ulna, metacarpals, and phalanges but different functions.
 
• The forelimb of the whale is used in swimming, a bat's forelimb is used for flight while a cheetah uses the forelimb for running. 
 
• Homologous organs always show divergent evolution
 
• Vestigial organs: The remnant organs of our past ancestors that are now today considered ''use-less'' are called Vestigial organs

questions.question: What is the resistance (in Ω) of an electrical component if a current of 0.2 A passes through it on the application of 8 V of a potential difference across it?
questions.solution:
The resistance of an electrical component if a current of 0.2 A passes through it on the application of 8 V of a potential difference across it is 40 Ω.

Formula: Potential Difference V = Current I × Resistance R

R = V ÷ I

So,

= 8 ÷ 0.2

= 40Ω.

Resistance is the hindrance offered to the current in its passage through the conductor.

questions.question: The value of acceleration due to gravity (g) ________.

options.text: is greater at the poles than at the equator
is lesser at the poles than at the equator
is greater at the North pole than at the South pole
is greater at the South pole than at the North pole

questions.solution:
The value of acceleration due to gravity (g) is greater at the poles than at the equator.

 
• Since the earth is flattened at the Poles and bulged at the Equator, the Poles are nearer to the center of the earth than the Equatorial region.
 
• As acceleration due to gravity is inversely proportional to the distance, the poles being at a lesser distance from the center of the earth have more value of acceleration due to gravity.
 
• The acceleration produced by the force of attraction of the earth is known as acceleration due to gravity i.e., g

 F = ma = mg

questions.question: Seismic waves are recorded by an instrument called the ________________.
questions.solution:
Seismic waves are recorded by an instrument called the seismograph.

 
• The tremors produce vibrational disturbances or waves on earth’s surface. These waves are called seismic waves.
 
• The seismic waves are recorded by an instrument called the seismograph. It measures and determines the magnitude of an earthquake.
 
• The record produced by the seismograph on a display screen or paper printout in form of a graph showing motion of the ground over a period of time is called the seismogram.

questions.question: On 3 January 2018, Lok Sabha passed Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (Amendment) Bill, 2017. The Bill seeks to permit construction in ‘Prohibited areas’ for ______.
questions.solution:
On 3 January 2018, Lok Sabha passed Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (Amendment) Bill, 2017. The Bill seeks to permit construction in ‘Prohibited areas’ forPublic Purposes.

 
• The Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (Amendment) Bill, 2017 amends the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958.
 
• AMASR Act, 1958 prohibits construction in the ‘prohibited areas’ even if it is for public purposes. TheAncient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (Amendment)Bill,2017 amends this provision and permits construction of public works in these particular areas for public purposes.
